name: Phone Calls & Voicemail
equipment: A notebook and a partner (or mirror) to practice speaking aloud
instructions: This lesson focuses on phone calls & voicemail — practice these key phrases out loud:
Hello, this is Alex speaking. How can I help you?
Could you hold for just a moment, please?
I'm sorry, could you repeat that? The line's a bit unclear.
Please leave your name and number after the tone.
Try using at least three of these phrases in a short role-play conversation with a partner (or out loud to yourself).
